description: Données Ouvertes sur les Retenues d'Eau Collinaires au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l’Eau et de l’Assainissement . Les retenues d'eau collinaires sont des infrastructures hydrauliques construites pour capter et stocker les eaux de pluie ou de ruissellement. Elles jouent un rôle crucial dans la gestion des ressources en eau, particulièrement dans les zones rurales et agricoles. Lien vers la source: Cliquez ici Donnée privée, accessible uniquement sur demande. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de l’Eau et de l’Assainissement . It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support dam, reservoir and flood defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
